title: Do Recommenders Need to Think in Words? Latent Reasoning for Efficient LLM-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based recommender systems increasingly generate chain-of-thought (CoT) text before each item prediction to activate the LLM's reasoning capacity, costing tens to hundreds of extra tokens per recommendation at inference. We ask whether inference-time reasoning artifacts (textual or latent) can be replaced by training-time supervision alone, without loss of accuracy. We propose LatentRec, a framework for LLM-based generative recommendation that replaces inference-time reasoning artifacts with training-time per-step head supervision. LatentRec has three components. A 2.5M-parameter Continuous Thought Module iterates K latent reasoning steps over the LLM's hidden state during training. Soft Token Selection bridges the ~14x norm gap between hidden states and input embeddings. translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统越来越多地在每次物品预测前生成思维链（CoT）文本，以激活LLM的推理能力，但这在推理阶段每次推荐需要额外消耗数十到数百个token。我们提出一个问题：推理阶段的推理产物（文本形式或潜在形式）能否仅通过训练时的监督来替代，而不损失准确率？为此我们提出LatentRec，一个基于LLM的生成式推荐框架，它用训练时的逐步预测头监督替代推理时的推理产物。LatentRec包含三个组件：一个250万参数的连续思维模块，在训练期间对LLM的隐藏状态迭代K步潜在推理；软token选择机制，用于弥合隐藏状态与输入嵌入之间约14倍的范数差距；逐步推理损失（PRL），通过LLM的预测头对每个中间状态进行监督，目标为语义ID的首个token。经过训练的
tldr: LatentRec框架用训练时的逐步潜在推理监督替代推理阶段的思维链文本生成，在不损失准确率的前提下大幅降低基于LLM推荐的推理开销。
en_tdlr: LatentRec replaces inference-time chain-of-thought reasoning in LLM-based recommendation with training-time latent per-step supervision, achieving comparable accuracy at a fraction of the inference cost.
